verdict.rationale: Groq is an LLM inference API. Its evidence covers chat completions, structured outputs, tool use, remote MCP and batch processing. These are developer building blocks that a user could call to build insights from their own data, not an in-product feature that surfaces AI-generated insights or suggestions. No evidence shows a console or dashboard capability that analyzes the user's data and offers insights, so the applicable axis is unevidenced.
